purpose: Separate source-text support from proof that a rule applies to the merchant situation.
scope_origin: Explicit structured settings with provenance; neither retrieval similarity nor model inference establishes scope. Free-text assertions must be confirmed as structured settings before authorizing specialized advice.

decisions.applicable: Every reviewed requirement matches established trusted scope. Evidence can support claims within that scope.
decisions.requires_clarification: At least one essential setting is unknown and none contradicts. Retain provenance for diagnosis; do not assert specialized advice. Request specific setting.
decisions.inapplicable: At least one established setting contradicts a reviewed requirement. Exclude from answer evidence even if another setting is unknown.
decisions.unreviewed: No reviewed scope map exists for specialized evidence. Quarantine for source review; absence of known exclusions is not authorization.

requirements: Use full publisher ancestry and most-specific subsection.
Map requirements from source review, not from gold membership.
Distinguish named subtype from broad reason-code family; matching code alone is insufficient.
A country name cannot establish Participating Countries membership.
Exceptions modify only their explicit referent; incomplete exception clauses cannot waive other requirements.
Retain applicable general evidence so safe partial answers remain possible.
Applicability does not establish semantic support or citation entailment.
No production use until scoped coverage, wrong-scope exclusion and no-blanket-abstention gates are measured.
baseline_policy: Frozen dev cases, gold, packs, attempts and scores unchanged; all additions separately versioned. Holdout untouched.
